clips.title: The story
paras: While scouting the Ironforge stronghold of Dun Garok under orders from High Executor Darthalia, Deathguard Humbert stepped away from his camp to collect firewood. Dwarven scouts looted his campsite and made off with his personal weapon, leaving the humiliated sentry desperate to recover it before his commanding officer notices.

Tasked by High Executor Darthalia with keeping a watchful eye on Dun Garok, Deathguard Humbert took up a concealed vigil near the dwarven fortress. When morning broke, he briefly left his outpost unguarded to gather firewood for boiling water. That lapse was all the opportunistic Ironforge dwarves needed. Upon his return, Humbert found his camp looted and his trusty sword gone, taken deep into the heavily defended bunker.

Losing a weapon to the very enemy one is supposed to surveil is an embarrassment punishable by death under Forsaken command. Humbert knows full well that High Executor Darthalia would string him up from the rafters of Tarren Mill if she ever learned of his blunder. Unable to storm the stronghold alone, he depends on passing Horde adventurers to plunge into Dun Garok and reclaim his blade before Darthalia realizes anything is amiss.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance. I had set up camp just out of sight. But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.
When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.

Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it. I need my sword! If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful. So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to retrieve my sword, friend? High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, I feel so complete with my precious sword back in my hand. Many thanks to you!
